messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "depressive episodes associated with bipolar I disorder"
set: ["depressive episodes associated with bipolar I disorder", "bipolar I depressive episodes", "bipolar disorder", "major depressive disorder", "Major depressive disorder (MDD)", "pattern refers to seasonal major depressive episodes", "bipolar disorder or mania", "more likely in people with bipolar disorder", "major depressive disorder in adults", "edema associated with nephrotic syndrome", "edema associated with renal disease", "acute and maintenance treatment of major depressive disorder", "40mg for major depressive disorder (MDD) and OCD", "nausea and vomiting associated with MEC", "nausea and vomiting associated with radiotherapy", "edema associated with congestive heart failure"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
